description: Tyranitar Mega Evolves (Sand Stream starts again and replaces Abomasnow's snow; Speed 113 -> 123 now outruns Gyarados' 118, Atk/Def change) and uses Iron Head on Gyarados, which tries to Dragon Dance (a flinch from the now-faster Mega stops it). Abomasnow and Excadrill Protect. Intimidate from the start applies to both formes.
